title: 0–30 V 0–5 A bench DC power supply

sources.citation: The single-output 0–30 V, 0–5 A linear laboratory supply, a common bench class with constant-voltage and constant-current regulation and automatic crossover. Typical published figures for the class, paraphrased (not one vendor's): CV load regulation within about 0.01 % + 2 mV from no load to full load, so about 5 mV at 30 V over 5 A, an output resistance of about 1 mΩ; case about 130 mm wide, 160 mm tall and 270 mm deep.

game-design: the − and + binding posts sit on the front panel 35 mm above the bench, 19 mm apart (the 0.75 in spacing of dual banana plugs, a common bench convention); the layout is not modelled on a product.
